notes:
Background: mid-market product analytics SaaS, conversational assistant in product UI + search reranking for help center. Ran 3-week Hosted API trial to validate latency and cost profile.

Trial summary (short):
- Successes: integration straightforward, SDK + streaming worked, devs up & running in 2 days.
- Pain: spikes in peak-hour latency when long completions + embeddings requests overlapped. Need Dedicated sizing to hit 99th pct latency SLOs.

POC metrics observed (hosted API trial):
- request profile: 78% short-chat (prompt ~120 tokens), 12% long-completion (prompt 350 tokens, completion avg 420 tokens), 10% embeddings/batch rerank (avg 1024 tokens per doc).
- tokens per API call: median 180, mean 220 (skewed by long completions).
- throughput: baseline 8-14 QPS during business hours, peak observed 36 QPS (two one-hour spikes).
- concurrency: typical concurrency 9-16, peak concurrent streams 34.
- latency: p50 ~110 ms (generation only), p95 ~740 ms during peak on hosted; embedding calls p95 ~1.2s.
- error rate: 0.6% transient 5xx during two spikes linked to regional throttling/fallbacks.
- cost: Hosted run estimated $5k/month at baseline; extrapolated monthly cost at steady 40 QPS baseline ~ $25k/month (unacceptable).

What Larkspur needs from Dedicated sizing:
- target steady-state QPS to provision: 12 QPS baseline, headroom to 45 QPS peak.
- target concurrency goals: p95 latency < 800ms for short-chat & <1.5s for embeddings under peak.
- token mix assumptions: 80% chat (short -> <512 tokens), 12% long completion (avg 700 total tokens including completion), 8% embeddings/bulk rerank (avg 1024 tokens).
- KV/prefix caching: business expects 25% repeat prefixes (session history) that could benefit from KV cache; want recommendations from Redwood Optimize.

Commercial / procurement notes: 
- procurement wants a committed monthly GPU pool price + overage rates. They prefer monthly commit with ability to burst. Ask: example committed capacity tiers, billing cadence, SLA credits.
- internal finance wants 12-month ARR forecast to justify dedicated commitment; estimate $90k ARR preferred minimum to sign.

Security & compliance:
- must support SSO/SAML and audit logs forwarded to their SIEM.
- data residency: primary in us-east, with option to pin to EU for customer subset.
- KMS integration required for encryption-at-rest keys.

capacity_sizing_notes: Requested by Larkspur: baseline 12 QPS sustained, burst to 45 QPS; target model family: open Llama-variant or Redwood-curated 7B/13B optimized; quantization suggested for embeddings to reduce GPU footprint; recommend 2 GPU pool config (baseline + burst), autoscale policy with graceful fallback to smaller model variant.
traffic_forecast: Quarterly forecast (conservative): Q2 expected avg 12 QPS -> ~32M tokens/day (peak days 90M tokens), monthly tokens ~960M. Cost sensitivity: medium-high, prefer a price per GPU-hour + token floor. Forecast assumptions documented in Drive deck.
poc_results_summary: Hosted API validated feature parity and SDK ergonomics. Performance requirements unmet under burst – Dedicated expected to reduce p95 by ~30-50% based on Redwood sizing model. Need formal benchmark on dedicated pool with their 13B quantized profile.
pricing_notes: Procurement requests: committed monthly rate tiers (small/medium/large), add-on burst buffer pricing, SLA (99.9%) terms, sample invoice. Also asked for clear overage calculation (GPU-hour vs token).
